message: Por donde estoy en Kennedy el agua ya tapa la parte baja del bordillo. No me atrevo a decir cuántos centímetros tiene: desde acá no puedo medirla. #inundacion #Bogota

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0009: Close-up handheld phone photo aimed at the edge of a sidewalk in Kennedy, Bogotá: murky shallow rainwater covering the lower part of the concrete curb; black iron fence and narrow wet garden strip at top. The water depth cannot be measured; focus on gentle ripples at curb, damp fallen petals and rough pavement. No grate in frame, no people, no zebra crossing, natural overcast afternoon.
